biggest_catch: This is a limited-time offer with no fixed end date ('may be discontinued at any time'), and the full $1,000 requires parking $10,000+ of new money in the account for 135+ days plus completing $2,000 in direct deposits.
catches: Limited-time offer with no stated end date — it may be discontinued at any time without prior notice.
The $500 checking bonus requires ACH credits totaling at least $2,000 within 60 days of opening; internal transfers do not count.
The Balance Build credit requires depositing $5,000+ ($250) or $10,000+ ($500) of NEW money within 15 days of opening and maintaining it for 120 more days — significant cash tied up.
The $500 bonus is credited within 120 days after the bank determines requirements are met — slow payout.
Customers who previously received any new-account bonus from Columbia Bank are ineligible, even for a new account; joint accounts: if the primary tax owner got one before, the account is excluded.
One new-account bonus and one Balance Build bonus per customer; joint and trust accounts get only one each.
The Advantage Plus Checking account has a $10/month maintenance fee — waived with $1,000+ in ACH credits or 3+ bill pays/external ACH debits per cycle.
Bonuses are reported to the IRS as interest (taxable income) on Form 1099-INT.
Columbia Bank is a New Jersey community bank; eligibility is generally limited to NJ residents or people who work in NJ.

steps: Open a new Columbia Bank Advantage Plus Checking account (minimum opening deposit $0.01).
Within 60 days of opening, receive ACH credits totaling at least $2,000 in the checking account (internal transfers do not count).
Optionally: within 15 days of opening, deposit $5,000+ of new money (not previously held by Columbia Bank) for a $250 Balance Build credit, or $10,000+ for $500; maintain the deposit for 120 days.
Keep the account open; receive the $500 bonus within 120 days after qualification is confirmed and the Balance Build credit within 30 days after the 120-day seasoning period.
Avoid the $10 monthly fee by keeping $1,000+ in ACH credits or 3+ bill pays/external ACH debits per statement cycle.
